title: HB 180 (2025 Regular Session): AN ACT relating to elections.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id) not stated.
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) Section 1, KRS 117.228(1)
(quote) if a voter is unable to provide proof of identification as required under KRS 117.225, and as defined under KRS 117.001, a voter may cast a ballot if the individual:
(section) Section 1, KRS 117.228(2)(d)-(e)
(quote) STRUCK: [; or (e) A credit or debit card with the name of the voter stated]
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Section 1 is the only section. It reprints KRS 117.228 and its only change is to strike the credit or debit card from the documents a voter without photo ID may show (the Social Security card, county ID card, photo ID card and state benefit card stay in the list).
(other) version: orig_bill (only saved version, as introduced): carries the slot b change; slots a, c, d, e not stated. Text is word-for-word the same as KY-HB-374-2024 apart from header lines.
(other) note: The 117.228 voter affirmation (item 1: 'The voter is a citizen of the United States') and the personal-knowledge exception in subsection (4) are reprinted unchanged. 'Proof of identification' is only referenced ('as required under KRS 117.225, and as defined under KRS 117.001'), not restated, so slot a is not stated. The bill text is identical to the other year's card-removal bill (HB374 of 2024 and HB180 of 2025); only the bill-request number and print date in the header differ. Never left committee (last action 2025-02-04: to Elections, Const. Amendments & Intergovernmental Affairs (House)).
